rewrites.//: SPA fallback. Excludes paths with a file extension (e.g. /favicon.svg, /robots.txt, /install.sh) so Vercel serves them as static assets from public/ — the previous unconditional /(.*) rewrite was returning index.html for every static-asset request, breaking SEO crawlers + favicon + sitemaps.

headers.//: Hashed asset bundles never change once shipped (Vite emits content-hashed filenames). Tell browsers + intermediaries to cache them forever so repeat visits never re-fetch ~100 KB of JS/CSS.

Defense-in-depth response headers on every HTML response. CSP intentionally permissive on style/script to allow inline tags from Vite's dev-flow + Tailwind's runtime style injection; tighten once the bundle is audited.

headers.value: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()
